purpose: Focused static and dynamic closure audit for player contact, helper 5937, factory 0E06, input dispatch, moving platforms, and held-out parity.

contracts.name: apply_descriptor_vertical_correction_3D02
contracts.inputs: ES:DI player; +0x3B gate; +0x04/+0x08 integer probe coordinates; descriptor word from 5CC3
contracts.outputs: AL/ZF branch contract: 3DF1 positive response, 3DE4 rejected response, 3D44 clear retry; +0x3A latch

contracts.name: snap_player_y_on_side_contact_3DF2
contracts.outputs: no flag contract used by callback; integer Y low three bits cleared when either ordered probe is occupied

contracts.name: probe_player_side_clear_3A1F
contracts.outputs: ZF/CF-compatible clear result; writes +0x3B=0xFF only after both probes are clear; first occupied probe short-circuits

contracts.name: player_helper_5937
contracts.inputs: DS:85DA gate; DS:60D8/60DA change word; DS:881C, DS:880A, DS:880C, DS:4FF2, DS:4FF6, DS:4FF8, DS:4FFA auxiliary state
contracts.outputs: far return to 01F7:5BED; no player-record return value is consumed by 3FF8; external dispatches receive event-specific AX/BX/CX
contracts.relation_to_transition_gate: 3FF8 calls 5937 before testing DS:89EA; 5937 has no direct read/write of DS:89EA. Indirect dispatch effects remain unproven.
contracts.ordinary_gameplay: ordinary callback entry and return are observed; no direct player or transition-global mutation was observed in the ordinary trace window

contracts.name: object_pool_factory_0E06
contracts.inputs: AX=requested callback offset; DX caller-supplied initializer word (contact call uses AX=0x6328, DX=0)
contracts.outputs: ES:DI first free object or allocator failure; scheduler insertion through 01F7:1036
contracts.family_selection: the caller selects the callback; 0E06 itself supplies common defaults and does not select a gameplay kind. Contact callers request 0x6328; leaf/entity callers request their own callback.
contracts.ownership_lifetime: pooled first-free ownership; callback clear makes a slot reusable; stale bytes are not cleared by this allocator edge; phase +0x17=1 is inserted into the scheduler bank
contracts.collision_effect: the player contact caller uses the created child as a contact/effect callback. No evidence shows the child entering solid collision queries; collision response is performed by the player before/around the factory call.

contracts.name: contact_child_callback_6328
contracts.inputs: pooled child record; callback-state +0x32; child state/index +0x2E; fixed-point position
contracts.outputs: short-lived child update; callback is cleared when its terminal +0x2E state is reached
contracts.collision_role: no solid-collision read is present in the recovered child contract; it consumes the contact/effect position and is presentation/effect-side until an indirect subhelper proves otherwise
contracts.ownership_lifetime: owned by the shared pool; allocator defaults are inherited from 0E06 and terminal callback clear makes the slot reusable

contracts.name: read_normalized_action_bits_F21B__input_dispatch_F21C
contracts.inputs: DS:88BC keyboard make/break state and DS:8196 secondary action source
contracts.outputs: AX = DS:88BC | DS:8196; no flags or side-effect contract is consumed beyond AX
contracts.simultaneous_precedence: dispatch is bitwise OR with no precedence; callback horizontal acceleration tests right before left, and 0x22 is consumed as a combined vertical action gate
contracts.edge_vs_held: F1A8 stores held make/break state. No rising-edge detector exists at F21B/F21C; callback throttling uses +0x40 reset/increment and the +0x40<=0x0D/+0x3E gate.
contracts.suppression: DS:656C is used as a scripted action source when DS:85DA>0; DS:89E6 later zeroes the action word. +0x39 injects mode/action state before suppression.
contracts.computed_jump: the malformed computed tail remains address-named; no semantic target is assigned

contracts.name: platform_player_overlap_A075
contracts.inputs: platform object geometry and live player position
contracts.outputs: DS:5006=-1 on strict horizontal overlap and player_y in [object_y, object_y+12)

contracts.name: platform_publish_player_carry_A0B2
contracts.inputs: platform motion and accepted DS:5006 overlap latch
contracts.outputs: DS:8816 horizontal fixed delta; DS:8812 vertical fixed delta; platform +0x5A=FF, +0x59=0

descriptor_response.gate: +0x3B==0 returns before a new response; accepted response clears +0x3A first
descriptor_response.retry: if descriptor&0x30==0, decrement Y by 8 and reread; restore Y only when retry also has descriptor&0x30==0
descriptor_response.acceptance: target=(Y&0xFFF0)+phase+[8 if bit 0x40 clear]; original Y < target clears +0x3A and returns 3DE4; otherwise optional Y correction returns 3DF1
descriptor_response.interpretation: 0x20/0x40 are response/alignment controls. One-way and floor/ceiling names are not assigned from these bits alone.

callback_order.condition: 3DF2 is entered only on side-occupied, nonzero-gate, or nonzero-response ordinary joins
the reachable 4323 path does not call descriptor correction helpers
